headword: {敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}
reading: はいしゃふっかつせん

definitions.explanation: A supplementary competition that gives eliminated participants a second chance to advance, common in tournament-style competitions.

examples.japanese: {敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}で{勝|か}ち{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I advanced through the repechage round.

examples.japanese: この{大会|たいかい}には{敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}があるので、{一度|いちど}{負|ま}けてもチャンスがある。
examples.english: This tournament has a consolation round, so there's still a chance even after losing once.

examples.japanese: {一回戦|いっかいせん}で{敗退|はいたい}したが、{敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}から{這|は}い{上|あ}がって{決勝|けっしょう}まで{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: I was eliminated in the first round, but fought my way back through the repechage to reach the final.

notes:
A compound of {敗者|はいしゃ} (loser, defeated person), {復活|ふっかつ} (revival, comeback), and {戦|せん} (match, battle). This format is common in Japanese sports tournaments ({柔道|じゅうどう}, {相撲|すもう}, etc.), TV talent competitions, and quiz shows.

The concept is equivalent to a repechage in Western sports terminology, particularly in rowing and martial arts at the Olympics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}に{回|まわ}る: to drop to the repechage bracket
- {敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}から{勝|か}ち{上|あ}がる: to win back from the losers' bracket
- {敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}{出場|しゅつじょう}: appearing in the consolation round

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {予選|よせん}: preliminary round — the initial qualifying stage, before the main competition
- {決勝戦|けっしょうせん}: final match — the championship round
- {準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}: semifinal — the round before the final
